title: Conditional Specialist Governance Sufficiency Audit Disposition

the_governor.role: Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and IP Governance Authority
the_governor.findings: Governor already enforces strict no-assumption rules for jurisdiction, legal obligations, and compliance frameworks. Distinguishes technical security (Cipher) from legal/regulatory governance. Material uncertainty maps to human_review_required. Does not assume legal authority from architecture profiles.

weaver.role: Visual Modeling and Diagram Generation Specialist
weaver.findings: Weaver enforces source-to-model traceability, marks conflicting facts CONTRADICTED, preserves UNKNOWN without invented connectors, and invalidates diagrams on semantic source fact changes while preserving validity across cosmetic layout changes. Diagram validation remains explicitly non-authorizing.

cloak.role: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Layout, and Frontend Design Specialist
cloak.findings: Cloak explicitly enforces that hidden UI navigation is not backend authorization. Permission states describe user-visible limitations without leaking policy details. Backend enforcement remains mandatory under Cipher. UI visibility != authorization invariant is strictly preserved.

dagger.findings: Dagger remains gated and simulation-first with live destructive execution strictly blocked. No new governance capability added. Guardrails, rollbacks, and handoffs to Overseer, Cipher, and Ponytail are fully functional.

known_limitations: MigrationRiskContract v1 UNKNOWN production presence remains a pre-contract schema gap.
AR-3, AR-4, and v1.8 publication remain unauthorized.
